title: Routing sidecar: streaming enrichment and per-hop cost-delta telemetry
creator: Priya Shah
description: Problem: Route decisions (region selection, tier routing, fallback model variant) currently produce large, heterogeneous logs spread across services, which makes deriving per-request rationale and per-hop cost deltas expensive and slow for SLO/incident analysis. Goal: introduce a lightweight routing 'sidecar' enrichment step that attaches a compact routing rationale and computed per-hop cost-delta metrics to each decision event and streams these enriched events to the telemetry pipeline with configurable sampling. This project designs the sidecar interface, proto schema, privacy redaction rules, cost-delta computation (estimating token + compute cost per hop given model variant and quantization), and rollout plan across hosted/dedicated/private deployments.
tasks: Design sidecar event proto and field set (rationale_id, region, tier, variant, estimated_token_cost, estimated_compute_ms, sample_score)
Implement sidecar as an async enrichment layer in the routing service (Go) — low-latency path: fire-and-forget to telemetry queue
Add per-hop cost estimator module using model profiles (lookups for per-token cost & latency by variant/quantization)
Integrate redaction hooks for PII: prompt prefixes and user-identifiers must be hashed/suppressed per privacy policy
Add sampling knobs: deterministic sampling by request fingerprint, adaptive sampling by error rate or cost delta
Backfill connectors: map sidecar events to existing ingestion topic (kafka: topic=telemetry.routing.enriched) and update downstream processors
E2E tests: verify enrichment fields, sampling behavior, and retention TTLs in staging
Dashboard: create a per-route 'decision-cost-delta' panel in Console to validate impact
Prepare rollout plan and canary: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% across regions with circuit-breaker
Docs: Confluence design, telemetry schema registry entry, and API note for private customers
acceptance_criteria: Routing events include sidecar_enriched=true and the new schema fields for >=95% of sampled requests in canary
Per-hop estimated_token_cost and estimated_compute_ms correlate with offline billing estimates within 15% error for sampled traces
Sidecar latency contribution to p95 request is <5ms for the async fire-and-forget path
PII redaction compliant with security policy (verified by SRE/security review)
Console dashboard surfaces per-route cost-delta and can filter by region/tier/variant
Rollout can be throttled/disabled via runtime flag without code rollback
